persona.goal: transcribe and drop high-WER clips (references provided)
persona.opening_prompt: I have recordings together with their correct transcripts - run speech recognition on them and throw out the ones where the result is way off from the correct text.
persona.persona_facts: Reference transcripts are present in the manifest.
persona.preferences: When asked the bar, say drop worse than 25%.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I have recordings together with their correct transcripts - run speech recognition on them and throw out the ones where the result is way off from the correct text.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Here's my plan, grounded in the catalog.

**What you're asking for** is a classic **transcribe → WER-filter** pipeline: run ASR to get a hypothesis, compare it against your known-correct transcripts, and drop rows where the two diverge badly. This matches the built-in `fleurs-asr-wer-filter` blueprint, adapted to read *your* manifest instead of downloading FLEURS.

**Stages selected (from `cards`, nothing invented):**
- `ManifestReader` — reads your JSONL (each line needs `audio_filepath` + reference `text`).
- `InferenceAsrNemoStage` — ASR, writes `pred_text` (GPU; your RTX 4090 + `nemo_toolkit[asr]` are present).
- `GetPairwiseWerStage` — one `wer_pct` per row vs. the reference. I chose this over `ComputeWERStage` (they explicitly `conflict_with` each other): your goal is a single "how far off" number for a keep/drop decision, which is exactly what this cheap CPU stage produces. `ComputeWERStage` adds normalized CER/edge/PNC metrics you don't need here — say the word if you want normalized WER instead.
- `PreserveByValueStage` — keeps the good rows, drops the "way off" ones.

**Threshold — resolved, not hand-picked:** I ran `resolve GetPairwiseWerStage --label usable`, which maps to `wer_pct <= 25.0` via the card's own anchors (`0–10` = transcription-grade, `10–25` = usable, `>25` = "way off"). So rows worse than 25% WER are dropped.

**`validate` verdict: `runnable`** (0 errors). Produced roles: `pred_text`, `wer_pct`. Two warnings are expected and benign: `ManifestReader` is composite so the validator can't statically "see" that your manifest supplies the reference `text` (it must — that's the one hard data requirement), and a yield reminder. First ASR run downloads the model.

**Key assumptions (flagged):** (1) your manifest carries the reference transcript under `text` and the audio path under `audio_filepath`; (2) audio is 16 kHz mono — if not, prepend `ResampleAudioStage`/`MonoConversionStage`; (3) I defaulted to the **English** checkpoint `nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2` — swap `model_name` to match your language, or a wrong-language model will make everything look "way off." Next step after you supply the data path would be a bounded `smoke` run before any full run.

```recipe
stages:
  - {ref: ManifestReader, params: {manifest_path: REQUIRED}}
  - {ref: InferenceAsrNemoStage, params: {model_name: nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2}}
  - {ref: GetPairwiseWerStage, params: {}}
  - {ref: PreserveByValueStage, params: {input_value_key: wer_pct, operator: le, target_value: 25.0}}
  - {ref: ManifestWriterStage, params: {output_path: REQUIRED}}
```

This transcribes each recording with a NeMo ASR model, computes per-row `wer_pct` against your reference `text`, and keeps only rows at or below 25% WER (the card's "usable" anchor) — throwing out the ones where ASR came out way off — then writes the survivors to a JSONL manifest. The only preference-dependent knob, the "way off" cutoff, was resolved from the stage card's anchors rather than guessed; the sole assumption worth confirming is the language of your audio (drives `model_name`).

stages.summary: Build ALM training windows from audio segments, filtered by rate/bandwidth/speaker-count/duration.
Filter overlapping ALM windows, keeping those closest to the target duration.
Complete audio filtering/curation pipeline (CompositeStage) driven by a config.
Aggregate AudioTasks into a DocumentBatch DataFrame, stripping tensors/audio blobs.
Classify audio as full_band vs narrow_band (spectral RF) and filter/annotate.
Estimate effective audio bandwidth from the power spectrum; write to metrics.
Convert Traditional Chinese to Simplified (or other OpenCC conversions), per segment.
Compute WER/CER (plus edge-CER and optional PNC WER/CER) between hypothesis and reference text.
Download the FLEURS dataset and emit one AudioTask per transcript line.
Download the DNS Challenge 5 Read Speech set and emit one AudioTask per file.
Compute audio duration from the file and store it under duration_key.
Compute pairwise WER (%) between reference text and ASR pred_text.
Batched ASR transcription with a NeMo model; writes pred_text.
Speaker diarization (who spoke when) with NVIDIA Sortformer; passthrough or fan-out.
Inverse text normalization: spoken form -> written form (e.g. 'forty two' -> '42').
Rejoin transcripts/alignments of previously split audio back into the original file's metadata.
Read JSONL manifest(s) and emit one AudioTask per line (composite: partition + read).
Inner reader: turn a FileGroupTask into one AudioTask per JSONL line (streaming).
Append each AudioTask to a JSONL manifest file (final sink).
Merge word alignments into diarization segments (produce who-said-what text per speaker).
Convert to mono and (optionally) verify/resample to a target sample rate.
Transcribe and word-align audio with a NeMo ASR model (CTC/RNNT), producing word timestamps.
Drop empty segments and mutually-overlapping segment pairs.
Shape segments for TTS or ASR: merge same-speaker, then split on duration/pause/punctuation/bandwidth.
Keep/drop rows by comparing a numeric or string field against a target value.
Aggregate per-replica ALM pretrain metrics: append one JSONL record per task to a shard.
Speaker diarization + overlap detection with PyAnnote 3.1.
Read a JSONL manifest of long-form audios and emit one AudioTask per row (ALM pretrain source).
Resample/convert audio to a target sample rate (and format) via ffmpeg.
SIGMOS (ITU-T P.804) neural MOS across 7 quality dimensions; filter/annotate.
Concatenate nested VAD segments into a single combined waveform (with silence gaps).
Read audio slices from original files and write them as standalone segment files.
Plan snippet cut boundaries for one long-form audio (pure planning, no audio I/O).
Slice source audio per the snippet plan, mono-resample, and write snippets into a tar.
Append each (non-stub) ALM snippet's data as a JSONL line (snippet manifest sink).
Drop planned snippets whose transcript shows suspicious n-gram repetition (ASR degeneration).
Separate audio by speaker (NeMo SortFormer diarization) into per-speaker AudioTasks.
Composite: split long audio -> NeMo ASR align -> join transcripts/alignments back to originals.
Split long audio files into smaller pieces at natural pauses to keep speech coherent.
Normalize task data at the output boundary: build original_file/start/end/duration and copy passthrough keys.
Estimate PESQ / STOI / SI-SDR with the torchaudio SQUIM model; write to metrics.
Predict UTMOS mean-opinion-score (MOS) and filter/annotate audio by quality.
Silero VAD: detect speech and emit one segment per speech chunk (fan-out or nested).
Voice Activity Detection with WhisperX's VAD model; emit speech segments.

contract.description: Speech recognition inference using a NeMo ASR model.

params.name: model_name
params.description: Pretrained NeMo ASR model name. See full list at https://docs.nvidia.com/nemo-framework/user-guide/latest/nemotoolkit/asr/all_chkpt.html

params.name: cache_dir
params.description: Optional directory for model download cache. When set, NeMo stores/loads the pretrained checkpoint here instead of the default cache location.

params.name: filepath_key
params.description: Key in the entry dict pointing to the audio file.

params.name: pred_text_key
params.description: Key where the predicted transcription is stored.

card.summary: Compute WER/CER (plus edge-CER and optional PNC WER/CER) between hypothesis and reference text.

resource.throughput_hint: CPU; text cleaning + normalization (NeMo text processing)

good_for: measuring ASR accuracy (normalized WER/CER, edge-CER, PNC) for filtering
avoid_for: data with no reference transcripts (WER is unproducible)

params_of_note.edge_length: characters at each edge for edge-CER

param_dependencies.reference_text_key: requires reference transcripts in the source manifest

notes: Cleans/normalizes text via NeMo text processing before scoring. Writes results under metrics_key.

contract.description: Stage that computes Word Error Rate (WER), CER, edge CER, and optionally PNC WER/CER.

params.name: language
params.description: Language of the text. Defaults to "en".

params.name: hypothesis_text_key
params.description: Key to the hypothesis text. Defaults to "text".

params.name: reference_text_key
params.description: Key to the reference text. Defaults to "text".

params.name: num_words_threshold
params.description: Number of words to use for normalization. Defaults to 200.

params.name: num_words_look_back
params.description: Number of words to look back for normalization. Defaults to 5.

params.name: compute_pnc_wer
params.description: Whether to compute PNC WER/CER. Defaults to False.

params.name: pnc_chars
params.description: Punctuation characters to use for normalization. Defaults to special punctuation string.

params.name: edge_length
params.description: Length of the edge to compute CER. Defaults to 12.

params.name: segments_key
params.description: Key for the segments in the manifest. Defaults to "segments".

card.summary: Compute pairwise WER (%) between reference text and ASR pred_text.

good_for: a quick single WER% per row for accuracy filtering

params_of_note.wer_key: output key for the WER percentage (default wer_pct)

param_dependencies.pred_text_key: requires an upstream ASR prediction (e.g. InferenceAsrNemoStage)
param_dependencies.text_key: requires reference transcripts in the source manifest

contract.description: Compute pairwise word-error-rate (WER) as a percentage for each pair of text and pred_text.

params.name: text_key
params.description: Key for the utterance transcript. Defaults to "text".

params.name: pred_text_key
params.description: Key for the ASR predictions. Defaults to "pred_text".

params.name: wer_key
params.description: Key to store the computed WER percentage. Defaults to "wer_pct".

card.summary: Keep/drop rows by comparing a numeric or string field against a target value.

batch_size.reason: batch-only stage; process() raises, use process_batch

good_for: thresholding on a computed metric (e.g. keep wer <= 25, duration >= 1.0)
avoid_for: filtering before the metric field exists upstream

params_of_note.input_value_key: the field to compare (must be produced upstream)
params_of_note.operator: one of lt, le, eq, ne, ge, gt

param_dependencies.input_value_key: must be a key produced by an upstream stage (e.g. wer, duration)
